prompt_camara: Lit from the left by a brass diving lamp, a lean woman with light brown skin and wet auburn hair emerges from black water at low tide. Her face is half in shadow, one magenta accent. Dark eyes squint, lips parted, jaw set. Left hand grips the lamp’s metal base, white-knuckled; right hand presses a faded Polaroid photo against her chest, edges smudged. The photo shows a family at a table, image faint. A cracked satellite dish above glows magenta, suspended by rusted cables. Warm gold light from the lamp cuts through fog and rain, casting a narrow pool on the water. Cold blue contralight from the city horizon softly illuminates her head and hair edges. The lamp and water surface are softly blurred; the photo and face are sharp. The dish is desaturated, out of focus. City lights form a blurred vertical line in the lower third. High tonal contrast, firm blacks, aerographic gradients, grainy texture. Original machine design.
